data.notes: Confirmed June 2027 Hvar-relevant underground/diaspora listings are sparse; only route-based events that explicitly include Hvar and publish 2027 dates were included.

events.title: Yacht Week Croatia: Rhythm & Waves / Hip Hop & R&B Week
events.venueName: Yacht Week Croatia Original Route: Trogir, Brač, Hvar and Vis
events.summary: Yacht Week’s annual June diaspora-sound takeover of its Croatia Original route, explicitly including Hvar, with hip-hop, reggaeton, soca, dancehall, Moombahton and afrobeats across yacht parties, beach clubs, hand-picked DJs and a floating DJ deck.

events.title: Yacht Week Croatia — Hip Hop & R&B Week
events.summary: Yacht Week’s official Hip Hop & R&B Week page confirms its 2027 Week 26 dates as June 26–July 3 and states that the Croatia route includes Hvar, Vis and Milna. The program is a curated week of parties, floating DJ decks and beach-club moments soundtracked by hip-hop, reggaeton, soca, dancehall, Moombahton and afrobeats.

events.title: Sailweek Croatia Party Route — Week 26
events.summary: Official Sailweek 2027 dates list Week 26 of the Croatia Party Route for June 26–July 3, with the route stopping at Hvar/Palmižana. The event is a week-long sailing-party format featuring organized parties, DJs, raft parties and beach-bar stops.

events.title: Sailweek Croatia Party Route — Week 25
events.summary: Official Sailweek 2027 dates list Week 25 of the Croatia Party Route for June 19–26, with a Hvar/Palmižana stop. Sailweek describes the Croatia Party Route as combining sailing with beach bars, raft parties, DJs and a large summer social fleet.

events.title: Sailweek Croatia Party Route — Week 23
events.summary: Official Sailweek 2027 dates list Week 23 of the Croatia Party Route for June 5–12, with the route stopping at Hvar/Palmižana. The format includes organized parties, beach bars, raft parties and DJs across the sailing week.

events.title: Sailweek Croatia Party Route — Week 24
events.summary: Official Sailweek 2027 dates list Week 24 of the Croatia Party Route for June 12–19, with the route stopping at Hvar/Palmižana. The week is positioned as Sailweek’s classic party route, built around island hopping, DJs, beach bars and raft parties.
